items.title: What Costco Wholesale Holders Bought Into
items.summary: If you had looked at Costco Wholesale on 1 January 2026, you would have seen a warehouse giant that bulls argued could keep gaining share through more stores and high renewal rates, while bears worried that rich expectations left little room for error. For Costco Wholesale shareholders, the return from the start of the year was 28.0%, including dividends. If you were weighing an investment then, how much comfort would membership strength really have given you against that premium price...
